name: Mamoribito
source:
Phantom beast world where furry inhabitants live exists as parallel to human world. 

Kisaragi Kyosuke is working in Tokyo in a major company. On his 25th birthday he was informed that he is now a guardian to keep the balance between two worlds and prevent interference. Is it possible for him to maintain the balance between these two worlds?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
与人类世界平行的地方，存在着由兽人居民生活的幻兽世界。

如月恭介在东京一家大型企业工作。二十五岁生日当天，他得知自己如今已成为“护人”，职责是维持两个世界的平衡，防止彼此干涉。他真的能守住两界之间的平衡吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
